Keyless form generated mechanically first: jq -r '.questions[] | "=== \(.id) [\(.type)] \(.domain)\nQ: \(.question)" + options + scenarios + matching_options' (answer, rationale, distractor_patterns, primary_concept, theme, vertical, keywords all stripped). items.reasoning: Fairness = compare outcome quality across the two population groups and quantify the gap; the rest are transparency/privacy/monitoring.
Reliability & safety = detect when input quality leaves the model's validated envelope and fail over to humans.
Privacy/security beyond storage location = least-privilege scoping plus testing for extraction of personal data.
Inclusiveness = test with the excluded groups and provide an alternative channel where the modality fails them.
Transparency = disclose that it is AI and state its limits at point of use.
Accountability = named human owner plus governance framework over the decision.
A states the transparency obligation is met by broad disclosure + contest route; C names privacy/security as the countervailing obligation.
Hallucination: autoregressive token-by-token generation from pre-training patterns, no lookup.
One explanation covers both: generative output from learned patterns + fixed context window drops earlier text.
Image + text in one request = multimodal model.
A deployment has its own configuration/options fixed at deployment time.
Determinism/repeatability is a temperature (sampling) setting.

items.reasoning: Dictation->speech-to-text; scanned tickets->named values; email routing/terms->NLP; camera hazard->vision; read-aloud->speech.
Agentic = goal pursued across steps with actions taken, not a bigger/better writer.
Grouping reviews by what they are about + tracking rising subjects month to month = key phrase/keyword extraction.
Surfacing which people/orgs/places/dates a letter names so records can be linked = entity detection.
Mixed praise/criticism in one message needs aspect-level (opinion mining) sentiment, not document-level.
Act on substance without reading the full set = summarization.
Spoken debrief to indexable text = speech recognition (speech-to-text).
Held text read aloud on the visitor's phone = speech synthesis (text-to-speech).
Classify the product in the truck bed (label) + detect/locate each truck to count them.
Visuals for garments with no photographs = image generation from text.
Content-type classification by the medium each backlog arrives in.
Named values off many layouts with no per-layout code = field/document extraction, not OCR or per-layout templates.
Persistent role/tone/prohibitions belong in the system prompt; user question stays the user prompt.
Facts are right, shape is wrong -> few-shot examples showing the exact output layout.
Multi-step ordered arithmetic wrong -> chain-of-thought / step-by-step reasoning in the stated order.
Catalog entry is not callable; a deployment must exist before a client can call the model.
External app targets the deployment's endpoint with its address and credentials/key.
Fastest unbiased answer = try the deployment in the portal playground with real notes.
Embedding the model in an existing app = write client code with the Foundry SDK against the deployment.
Testing is part of creating the agent, and it must be exercised against realistic branch requests.
An agent is addressed as an agent via the SDK; it already carries its instructions and tools.

items.reasoning: Rung selection: single prompt, tool-calling agent, autonomous multi-step agent, multi-agent coordination.
Grounding on a knowledge base fixes both wrong-source answers and traceability (citations).
Fluency is not grounding; untraceable claims are exactly the failure grounding prevents.
Multi-requirement app = pick the right technique per stage and consume each structured result.
Attach the purpose-built Azure Language text analysis to the agent as a callable capability.
A multimodal model accepts the audio directly, removing the separate recognition step.
Azure Speech in Foundry Tools supplies recognition + synthesis as configured capabilities.
Custom/consistent voice under own control and vocabulary tuning + predictable latency are dedicated-speech drivers; B (portal config preference) is the runner-up.
Compose speech recognition and synthesis around the existing agent; the agent keeps its tools.
High volume, cost/latency ceiling and consistent shape = purpose-built text analysis capability.
Text analysis cannot read audio; recognition must run first and the text step runs on the transcript.
Photograph plus a report-shaped question in one request = deployed multimodal model.
Producing new visuals from a brief is image generation, a different model class from image reading.
Moving visual output from a written description = video generation model class.
Reading images and generating images are opposite directions; two model classes needed.

items.reasoning: Named values from many layouts = Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools.
Content Understanding covers images as well as documents; no separate image service needed.
Content Understanding handles audio and video content types directly.
One Foundry tool spans text, documents, images and audio; four services are unnecessary.
Extraction only pays off when the values are passed into the downstream register the process already uses.
Extraction is configured per content type; sort by type first, then run each configuration on its own group.
